svg.title: DMG-D3 loads in the pulls
svg.text: DMG-D3: each part pulled until its root gives - the cut's load over its break limit
Cub: the fin pulled sideways (off by bend, root)
Jodel: the fin pulled sideways (off by bend, root)
twin floatplane: the rod loaded down at its tail (off by bend, root)
twin floatplane: the rod levered over an obstacle at its station (off by bend, station)
twin floatplane: the rod twisted (a torque on its last ring) (off by twist, station)
twin floatplane: the left float dug in (off by member, root)
twin-boom FIXTURE: the left boom levered at its station (off by bend, station)
